newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia stock exchange ends week 0.26 pct higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia stock exchange ends week 0.26 pct higher.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange ended its Friday session 0.26 percent higher pushed up by increasing demand for liquid stocks, a bourse official said.

The 31-share index closed at 494.88 points, up from 493.61 points on the previous session. The index was at 492.45 points a week ago, the official said. The number of shares, which exchanged hands during the two-hour session, was 253,450, up from 69,978 shares on Thursday, he added.
Banque de Tunisie gained 1.72 dinars to 75.02 dinars on Thursday.
Industrie Chimique de Fluor firm rose 1.02 dinars to 46.24.
Al-Kimia chemical firm closed at 44.2 dinars up from 44 dinars.
Palm Beach Hotels fell 0.27 dinar to 10.5 dinars.
Total traded volume was 1.03 million dinars against 1.1 million dinars over the previous session.
